'''October 2000 Utica tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Wizards of the Coast store, Utica, Michigan in October 2000. [[Casey Galvan]] won it. It is known from Casey Galvan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1363">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-19-wotc-utica-mid1363/ wotc-utica-mi], DeckTech (Jason "TrenchRunner" Aubry, 19 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-19-wotc-utica-mid1363/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 2000
* '''Site:''' Wizards of the Coast store, Utica, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Casey Galvan]]
